subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Preview
overview: The Medford School Committee of the Whole met to approve three Massachusetts School Building Authority Statements of Interest and received a preliminary presentation on the fiscal year 2026 budget.

items.title: MSBA Accelerated Repair Statements of Interest
items.summary: Approved three separate motions authorizing the administration to submit Statements of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority Accelerated Repair Program for roof and heat pump projects at the Roberts, Missituck, and Brooks Elementary Schools.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Areas
items.summary: Budget Analyst Gerry McCue presented an overview of enrollment projections, class sizes, Chapter 70 state funding, override allocations, revolving funds, and initial budget requests from school principals and department directors.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations with administrators and the Medford Teachers Association.
